subject.title: feat: add portable table presentation blocks

question: Should the `table` presentation block and `tables` capability become a supported public plugin SDK contract in this form?
rationale: This is a permanent compatibility decision across third-party plugins and channel adapters, not only an internal Slack implementation detail.

options.title: Approve portable table API
options.body: Adopt this typed block as the canonical cross-channel contract after the delivery defect, branch refresh, and live proof gates are resolved.

options.title: Keep tables Slack-owned
options.body: Retain native table support through Slack-specific advanced payloads without expanding the portable plugin SDK union.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Defer or close the branch until maintainers agree on a narrower permanent contract.

recommendation.title: Approve portable table API
recommendation.body: Adopt this typed block as the canonical cross-channel contract after the delivery defect, branch refresh, and live proof gates are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: This account introduced several adjacent portable-presentation and native Slack chart contracts and is the current assignee.
